name: Michael Gahler - Après le § 71 - Am 17
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: 71a. Highlights the negative effects of trade liberalisation and structural reforms on Ukraine’s agricultural sector; urges the Commission to carry out a comprehensive social impact assessment of the accession process on rural communities and smallholders; stresses that land ownership transparency and anti-monopoly regulations must be enforced before further integration of agricultural markets;
